ingestion_flows.source_description: TC-SEC-003: batch Auto Loader feed of a credential-vault access-audit log (who accessed which stored secret, and when), materialized as a real queryable table AND additionally PGP-exported in the SAME pipeline update (target_type: external_sink). secret_value is AES-GCM encrypted at rest via target_config.encrypted_columns -- keyed off the SAME {{catalog}}.security.pii_encryption_key UC secret TC-SEC-001/TC-TRF-003 already reuse -- before the target table is ever materialized, and sink_config.post_export_archive.pgp_encryption re-exports that already-ciphertext row set as a PGP-encrypted ZIP, keyed off the SAME {{catalog}}.security.pgp_public_key_finance_egress_test UC secret TC-SNK-003 already provisions. Both call sites resolve their key via dbutils.secrets.get() at graph-definition time -- see docs/56_tc_sec_003.md for why this test is expected to currently surface (not silently pass around) a known, unresolved plaintext-key-in-Spark-query-plan exposure on the AES leg specifically.
